narrative.headline: 2020 Kia Telluride: exterior lighting leads the owner complaints
narrative.summary: Owners filed 718 complaints with NHTSA. Exterior lighting is the most reported area at 25%, followed by visibility and wipers (19%) and the engine (18%). The power train is the only area tied to a death (1), along with 2 injuries. The engine and electrical system draw the most fire reports (4 and 3), so both are worth a careful look.
